main.description: Checks extracted dive sites, by position, against the live (proposed or active) sites, with the duplicate test the AppView applies when indexing, and writes nothing. Lists each site given, in order. Only the AppView's configured segment importer may call it, with service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: More than 500 sites, a malformed id or an out-of-range position.

errors.name: NotImporter
errors.description: The caller isn't the configured segment importer, or none is configured.
